subject.title: feat(android): accept audio and document attachments via share sheet and composer

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this curated Android audio-and-document attachment contract once its delivery, lifecycle, and proof gaps are resolved?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Android capability with a protected maintainer label; maintainers need to confirm the intended supported attachment scope rather than treating the implementation details alone as product approval.

options.title: Sponsor the curated attachment scope
options.body: Accept audio plus the proposed curated document types after the three concrete behavior blockers and real-device proof are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the first Android expansion to the attachment kinds with complete timeline and lifecycle support, and track other MIME types separately.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause the PR if Android document intake is not currently a supported product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the curated attachment scope
recommendation.body: Accept audio plus the proposed curated document types after the three concrete behavior blockers and real-device proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed Android attachment surface, though the protected-label decision remains a broader maintainer choice.
